sections.title: What this site provides
sections.body: This is an information site for VANTFLOW. It explains SEO services and provides a path to book a fixed-price audit or discuss other SEO services.

sections.title: Enquiries and payment
sections.body: There are no on-site payments, checkout, or payment forms. After you enquire, any engagement terms, scope, timing, and payment arrangements are agreed off-site in writing.

sections.title: Scope and outcomes
sections.body: SEO work is professional service work, not a promise of a particular result. We make no guarantee of rankings, traffic, leads, or other search outcomes. The exact scope is agreed in writing off-site before work begins.

sections.title: Site information
sections.body: The information is provided in good faith, but it is not a guarantee that every page is complete, current, or suitable for your specific situation. Review the agreed scope before relying on a service proposal.

sections.title: Questions
